notes.title: NetherWorld's Official Release Date Trailer is OUT!
notes.notes:
Hey, Netherholics!
 

As advanced in our last update, tonight we announced our release date with an animated trailer at Future Games Show Live From gamescom 2025. So we can finally say that...


NetherWorld is coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch on SEPTEMBER 12th!!


After a loooong time of waiting, the tunnel's light is closer than ever! We hope you enjoy this extended version of the trailer below:
